labs.lab_name: Center for International Environment and Resource Policy
labs.research_summary: Policy-relevant interdisciplinary research and training on sustainable prosperity in a changing global environment.
labs.member_breakdown: 2 co-directors, 4 staff, 2 postdoctoral scholars, 1 associate research scholar, 3 junior research fellows, 4 predoctoral research fellows

labs.lab_name: The Edward R. Murrow Center for Global Diplomacy
labs.research_summary: Looks at how diplomacy works in practice, covering diplomatic history, public and small-state diplomacy and tradecraft.
